requirements: R1: Prevent internal tasks from being marked as done when their corresponding GitHub PR is closed without a merge

slices.title: Patch PR synchronization logic for closed-unmerged state
slices.jtbd: When implementing R1 for this epic, I want to update the PR status webhook or polling logic, so that tasks with PRs closed without merge remain active.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an active internal task linked to a GitHub PR
When the GitHub PR is closed but not merged
Then the internal task retains a non-done status, verified via unit tests
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce false-positive 'done' transitions due to unmerged PRs to 0
